intent.productGoal: Make the intended Redwood architecture true in runtime behavior without adding unrelated capabilities or inventing professional authority.
intent.capability: Correct Assurance 001 implementation defects and independently process the authorized full ENG001 raw corpus before truth comparison.
architecturalIntent: Build from frozen Build 001 SHA on a dedicated branch.
Keep source evidence, canonical model, method profile, approvals, and output artifacts separately inspectable.
invariants: No forced reconciliation or invented financial values.
No client release if any prerequisite gate is not passed.
Validation truth is not used before the engine run.
acceptanceEvidence: Full ENG001 raw-sheet integration artifact with post-run truth comparison.

decisions.decision: Use only Claims_Raw, Payments_Raw, AR_Snapshot_Raw, and GL_Monthly_Raw before Validation_Truth.
decisions.rationale: Prevents answer-key leakage into ingestion, mapping, reconciliation, or calculation.
